name: waffle-chart
title: Waffle Chart
description: A ten-by-ten grid where each cell is one percent; cells fill in a wave and new data washes across the grid.

perf.budget: A hundred plain views read three shared values, so a wave updates a hundred styles per frame for about a second. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The grid appears filled and new data changes the colours at once.
a11y.screenReader: One image whose name lists every slice and its share. Legend entries are buttons with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Legend entries are at least 44 pt tall.
